integrity: All finite checks were replayed from a standalone source file; infinite-dimensional asymptotic assertions rest on the displayed martingale and Yule embedding arguments, not finite experiments. Independent validation has not been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Fixed Bernoulli edge retention and uniform random recursive trees only; vertex terminality means no children in the ORIGINAL tree, not zero percolation-component degree.
The exact residual-variance formula applies for integers \(n\ge3\); the Gaussian limit is asymptotic for fixed \(p\in(0,1]\).
No theorem for preferential-attachment trees with nonuniform attachment or for percolation parameters varying with n.
title: Terminal-leaf proportions and Gaussian fluctuations in percolated recursive trees
